observations.label: Concentration
observations.text: Consumer Discretionary is 27% of equity names (17 of 63). Buffett favours concentration in understood businesses — but sector concentration is not the same as conviction concentration.

observations.label: Moat quality
observations.text: 16 names show wide-moat ROIC. This is the part of the book he'd like most.

observations.label: Leverage
observations.text: 7 names carry debt/equity >1.5 (CPRI, VIRT, LAMR, MA, PGY, MELI). Balance-sheet risk is avoided regardless of business quality.

observations.label: Margin of safety
observations.text: 63 of 63 equities have no fair value set, so the price test cannot run. Closing this gap in expectations.yaml is the highest-value action.

observations.label: Track record
observations.text: GEMI, AVEX, FIGR listed under 12 months — no multi-year record exists, so the consistency test fails by construction.

observations.label: Index exposure
observations.text: 11 funds held — consistent with his standing advice for most investors, and excluded from every test above.
